summary: Standing R-6 cab on a 10-foot tower, built 1961 on the Snow Mountain summit; staffed each summer and listed as staffed in 2026.

access.note: Staffed Forest Service lookout. The site is legally accessible to the public, but that does not mean access to the lookout itself.

events.note: Lookout house established at the summit; the register calls the first station a cupola lookout.
Lightning storm set eleven fires across the district and burned out telephone parts at the station.
Al Frey needed to man the lookout through September 1927.
June 1928 notice: a Pacific University student to occupy the lookout.
New cab on a concrete foundation. Register and firelookout say L-4 ground house; the 1930 newspaper says R-1 Aladdin Jr.
Roy Nolen is lookout forest guard on the mountain (August 1938 newspaper).
Twelve fires reported from the station.
Present R-6 cab on a 10-foot treated timber tower; start work order August 1, final inspection August 24. An October 1961 memo reports rapid deterioration of the concrete footings.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on March 31, 2003.
Listed as staffed in the July 2026 directory.

corrections.why: Sources describe a 10-foot treated timber tower under the cab. No source gives a 61 m height. The 3.0 figure is the tower only, not the total height with the cab.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives a cupola lookout built in 1915. The 1930 newspaper says the replaced cabin was built in 1914. The story reports both dates.
The register and firelookout call the 1930 cab an L-4 ground house or cab. A 1930 newspaper calls it an R-1 Aladdin Jr. The story reports both.
The register gives 8,121 ft (2,475 m). The 2026 directory gives 7,163 ft. The record keeps the register figure; the sources do not explain the difference.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 61.0 is wrong; corrected to the 10-foot tower. Source 3 is a compiled history quoting newspapers and Forest Service files; all quotes were copied from its cached text. The 1930 cab type and the first cabin's date conflict between sources. Current access and visit details are thin: the only current sources are the staffed listing and the directory's legal-access column. The register's elevation differs from the directory's. The story gives no total height.
